0.0: Hello, traveler. I wonder if you've ever experienced being attacked by a monster while traveling around the beach. Please know that #o4230201# in particular is very poisonous.

0.2: But in order to continue with the studies, he looks like he needs more materials to work with. Since this is for everyone visiting the beach...will you help him out? I understand that it's hard work, but you also go visit the beach every once in a while.

yes.0: Now I can really start working on my research. Making antidotes... that shouldn't take long. Me, #p2012017# the genius, will succeed!
